_comment: Recipes by station. Station tiers and what each level unlocks follow the Crafting tab (Hearth levels 1-3 for the first playable). Input amounts are placeholders. 'pathMaterial' means one ember or frost essence may be added to infuse the item with that element. Station 'hand' = made anywhere, from the build menu (B). needsPerk: a life-skill stat the maker needs (the recipe stays hidden without it), needsText what the server says otherwise.
